assumptions.choice: Omit pre-market high from resistance level calculation, defining resistance level as max(Previous day high, First 5 minutes high).
assumptions.reason: The dataset provided in the execution environment consists strictly of regular market hours (09:30-15:55), so pre-market price data is absent.

assumptions.choice: Retest is registered when low <= resistance_level within 5 bars following a breakout close; bounce confirmation requires close > resistance_level and close > open.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires a candle confirming the bounce after price returns to the resistance level.

assumptions.choice: Position size derived from 1% risk at 0.5% stop-loss is capped by available cash.
assumptions.reason: Unleveraged 1% account risk at 0.5% stop-loss requires 200% equity position size, which exceeds available cash in standard 1x leverage accounts and causes order rejection.
